note: One file for the MSTX tab, the gap monitor and the TradingView indicator. Holdings and ADSO come live from api.strategy.com. btc_slope_per_2500 0.025 is Alex's sheet and matches the last three months' measured mNAV beta (0.81); it sets the projected price and therefore Cheap and Rich. lag_slope 0.0125 is DELIBERATELY different: the lag is a minute-scale deviation from its own trailing average, a different job from pricing a level, and it separates better at the lower slope. On 60 days of 5-minute bars at the bar low, distinct events 60+ minutes apart, 0.0125 at a -3.0% MSTX line gave 17 events (2.0/week), 65% positive at 60 minutes, median MSTX +0.49% and median MSTR-minus-BTC +0.28% -- the best hit rate of any slope and threshold pair tested. 0.025 at -3.0% was 13 events and 62% positive with a negative median on the market-neutral measure. Alex's call, 9/17. On 19 days of 1-minute bars the three slopes are statistically indistinguishable (10 to 15 events), so the 5-minute window is what this rests on. lag_threshold -0.015 = -3.0% MSTX, measured at MSTR's bar low (lag_at_low). lag_watch -0.01 = -2.0% MSTX, logged to the ledger without a push so the shallow zone keeps accumulating evidence. cheap_threshold -0.03 and rich_threshold 0.04 are MSTR terms; the Cheap and Rich tests run on the MSTX gap at twice these. regime_gate true.
